scripts.build: BUILD_ID=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d.%H%M%SZ) && npx esbuild main.js --bundle --conditions=source --loader:.css=text --loader:.svg=dataurl --loader:.txt=text --loader:.wasm=binary --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --minify --outfile=dist/bundle.js && sed "s/__BUILD_ID__/$BUILD_ID/g" index.html > dist/index.html && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp ../../packages/ui/fonts/*.woff2 dist/fonts/
scripts.dev: BUILD_ID=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d.%H%M%SZ) && npx esbuild main.js --bundle --conditions=source --loader:.css=text --loader:.svg=dataurl --loader:.txt=text --loader:.wasm=binary --sourcemap --outfile=dist/bundle.js && sed "s/__BUILD_ID__/$BUILD_ID/g" index.html > dist/index.html && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp ../../packages/ui/fonts/*.woff2 dist/fonts/
